prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 常用中药方剂组成与主治简表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "方名" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 2: header "组成" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 368px
  col 3: header "功效" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 138px
  col 4: header "主治" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 1195px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"供读者查阅常用方剂的组成、功效和主治，并比较不同方剂的用途。","reading":"先按方名定位，再横向阅读组成与功效、主治；比较方剂时可纵向扫描相同栏目。手机视口下需借助稳定的行边界追踪多行文字。","groups":["方名与组成共同说明方剂是什么、由哪些药物构成。","功效与主治共同说明方剂的作用和适用情况；功效较简，主治通常更详细。"],"keep_intact":["方名尽量保持完整，便于定位和识别。","药名、功效词和主治描述中的词语尽量不在词内拆开。"],"may_wrap":["组成可在药物之间自然换行。","功效和主治可按词语、标点及语义自然换行；较长主治形成的行高可容纳同一行中其他栏目的换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [98, 86, 62, 113] · table 360×1616px · row heights [36, 153, 176, 292, 153, 222, 339, 246] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 14 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [98, 78, 62, 121] · table 360×1616px · row heights [36, 153, 176, 292, 153, 222, 339, 246] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 14 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [90, 90, 62, 117] · table 360×1616px · row heights [36, 153, 176, 292, 153, 222, 339, 246] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 14 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"方名均保持单行，便于先定位方剂；组成与主治的宽度分配较均衡，行边界也有助于横向追踪。","problems":"功效和组成中出现较多短行，部分药名和功效词被换行切开；主治仍十分密集，长条目形成很高的行。","cause":"组成宽86px、功效宽62px，扣除内边距和边框后分别仅有65px和41px的文字空间；主治宽113px，也只能容纳较短的文字行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"方名单行完整，主治比r1A宽，阅读长段说明时横向空间稍充裕；各行仍可清楚区分。","problems":"组成栏显得过窄，药名和列表被切成许多短行，纵向扫描配方不顺；功效栏也有类似问题。主治增加的宽度没有改善给出的行高或最长行数。","cause":"组成从86px减至78px，文字空间只有57px；主治增至121px，但未跨过足以减少这些行高的换行阈值。功效仍只有62px。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"组成较前两版宽，部分药物列表的换行更舒展；功效与主治相邻，便于比较作用和适应情况。","problems":"较长方名折成两行，削弱了首列作为定位索引的作用；功效栏仍有零碎短行，长主治条目仍然密集。","cause":"方名宽90px，文字空间69px，小于最长方名的单行宽77px；功效宽62px，文字空间41px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-effect","widths":[98,86,70,105],"change":"以r1A为基础，保持方名单行及组成宽度，将8px从主治移给功效，检验能否让功效词组更完整，同时观察主治是否出现明显增高。"},{"name":"composition-first","widths":[98,94,62,105],"change":"保持完整方名，把组成加宽至94px，让药名和药物列表更易扫描；以较窄的主治换取组成栏的可读性，检验长主治是否跨过明显的增高阈值。"},{"name":"effect-treatment","widths":[98,78,70,113],"change":"从组成移出8px给功效，保持r1A的主治宽度，探索功效与主治共同获得较稳定阅读空间时的效果；重点检查组成是否过于零碎。"}]}
